name: LucidPro 50K · no daily loss limit
source: Account holder, 2026-09-27, pasted LucidPro 50K's rule table: account size $50,000; profit target $3,000; max loss limit $2,000; daily loss limit $1,200; max size 4 minis or 40 micros -- and said the daily loss limit can be removed as an option. Asked what hitting the daily limit does: it STOPS YOU FOR THE DAY (soft), the account survives. Earlier the same day: no consistency rule and no minimum days. Still INHERITED FROM FLEX and NOT confirmed for LucidPro: the lock (+$2,100 -> +$100 floor), the max loss being EOD-trailing, payout terms, scaling and session rules. CONFIRMED IN FULL by the account holder later on 2026-09-27 ("yes im confirming the lucid pro"), after being told the lock, EOD trailing and payout terms were copied from Flex: every number in this file is now the account holder's. PAYOUT (Lucid's pages, read 2026-10-11: https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/12890092-lucidpro-payouts and https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/12890109-lucidpro-consistency-percentage; the same terms the account holder gave on 2026-09-30, research/prop-portfolio/2026-09-29/FUNDED_RULES.md): NO winning-days rule. A payout needs (1) a cycle profit of $500 or more, (2) the largest single day at 40% of the cycle profit or less, (3) profit above the buffer = max loss + $100 ($52,100): it is paid only from what is above it. Minimum request $500 (needs $52,600). First payout at most $2,000 (needs $54,100), later ones $2,500 (needs $54,600). 90/10 split. No scaling plan: 4 minis / 40 micros from the first funded day. The 2026-09-27b files carried LucidFlex's payout rule (5 days of $150, 50% of profit) by mistake.
payout_ladder: first payout at most $2,000 (needs $54,100), later $2,500 (needs $54,600); goal, consistency and buffer reset after each payout; 90/10 split
notes: Only the FIRST payout is simulated; the ladder above is informational.
Trailing max loss is measured END OF DAY, not intraday: the floor moves up with EOD peak profit and never moves down.
The floor LOCKS at +$100 once EOD profit reaches +$2,100 — from then on the account cannot be trailed below +$100.
NO consistency rule and NO minimum trading days (account holder, 2026-09-27): `consistency: null` disables the check, `eval_min_days: 1` means a single day that reaches +$3,000 passes.
The daily loss limit REMOVED (an option on LucidPro, account holder 2026-09-27). No calendar time limit on the eval; the sim horizon stands in for 'eventually'.

PAYOUT, LucidPro's own (not LucidFlex's): no winning-days rule. Cycle profit >= $500, largest day <= 40% of the cycle profit, and paid only from the profit above the $52,100 buffer. Minimum request $500. The first payout is at most $2,000, so the MAXIMUM payout needs +$4,100 with the largest day at 40% of it or less.
Size: 4 minis = 40 micros in the eval and from the first funded day (no scaling plan). NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning when a ledger exceeds it.
Positions are closed by Lucid at 16:45 ET; holding to it does not fail the account. NOT enforced by the simulator.
NOT MODELLED: accounts bought or reset before 2025-11-28 use 35% consistency; what happens to the floor after a payout is not on Lucid's pages (only the first payout is simulated).
Eval rules confirmed by the account holder 2026-09-27; the payout terms are Lucid's published ones (2026-10-11).
disclaimer: Account-holder snapshot 2026-09-27 with LucidPro's own payout terms (Lucid's pages, 2026-10-11) — verify against LucidPro's current rulebook if Lucid changes its terms.
